answer: A harbor registry issues short-lived docking permits to agents: to dock, an agent must present a fresh receipt for verifiable useful work done in the last epoch, and the permit expires on a fixed tide so idle identities wash out. Because each permit costs one fresh proof, a Sybil farmer must redo real work for every puppet, every cycle. Agents may wander between harbors, but each new harbor re-checks the receipt chain, so a fake crew cannot clone one credential across many ports.
